correctness.rationale: The exact space-time transfer graph has been reconstructed from the Rule126 truth table. Exhaustive strongly connected component and elementary cycle enumeration at heights 1,2,4 yields precisely one trivial loop, one 6-state period-two component, and two 12-state period-four components, with all simple cycles sharing a vertex in each; the formal determinant trace then proves the formulas for all ring lengths. Independent direct C++ traversal verifies every state for \(3\le n\le20\). All recurrence coefficients, orbit division, \(n=49\) exclusion/\(n\ge50\) admission and unique Perron roots were checked. Finite brute force is used only as a cross-check; the finite graph certificate is the infinite-length proof.

value.rationale: Rule126 is a canonical nonlinear elementary automaton with existing finite attractor studies. Its exact natural temporal-four orbit invariant was not deducible from finite tables or one-step image formula. The sharp finite exclusion at circumference 49 and the mismatch between two- and four-cycle exponential growth rates distinguish dynamical complexity at different short periods and provide an all-length reproducibility benchmark.
